questions: What is a module?
If a module fails, does the rest still run?
What does revision involve?
When revision is finished, is the answer final?
What is reflection?
If the reflection is clear, does that mean the learning is clear?
What does voice mean?
If a voice is loud, has it been heard?
What does moderation do?
If moderation is strict, does less get through?
What is alignment?
If alignment is off, will it pull in one direction?
What is credit?
If the credit is transferred, does it have to be paid back?
What is engagement?
If the engagement is broken, does the relationship end?
What is a diagnostic?
If the diagnostic is negative, can support still be needed?
What is assessment?
If an assessment is passed, is the learning over?
What is a standard?
If a standard changes, does the old one become wrong?
What is a level?
When a level is completed, does everyone move to the next one?
What is a sequence?
If the sequence changes, does the ending have to change?
What is scaffolding?
When the scaffolding comes down, is the job finished?
What is an intervention?
If the intervention ends, is the problem cured?
